newsitem.title: singapore: Asian crudes up, Japan utilities provide support.
newsitem.headline: Asian crudes up, Japan utilities provide support.

text.p: Asian crude prices were assessed higher on Monday, as futures prices made a sharp come back on Friday.
Indonesian grades, which many sellers had feared would weaken in January because of West African imports, were holding firm with widespread support.
Stock building by China combined with utility purchases by Japan were underpinning key grades, traders said.
January Brent surged $1.01 to $23.53 and January NYMEX rose 75 cents to $24.47 on Friday. On Monday, SIMEX was quoted up at $23.54/$23.59 and NYMEX on ACCESS was 22 cents higher at $24.69.
